fusions.name: Drawn Out
fusions.desc: Your tongue strikes one enemy up to 5 tiles away for 16 damage, rising to 1.3 times that at its full reach. It draws out every affliction you have on the target, dealing 60% more damage for each one drawn.

fusions.name: Bitter Sweat
fusions.desc: Sacrifices 5% of your maximum health to spray the toxin out of your own skin 4 tiles ahead of you, dealing 8 damage to everything in the cone and leaving it [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Sloughed Skin
fusions.desc: Sheds your outer skin, removing up to 3 poison conditions from you and restoring 10 health. You move 20% faster for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Dose Makes the Cure
fusions.desc: When you inflict a condition, you regain 3 health a second for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
